description: When a favourite and a cheaper non-favourite both match, ShopperHound picks the favourite.

input.userMessage: Shop 'milk' where a cheaper Whole Milk and a favourite Semi Skimmed both match.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BasketResult whose single line is the favourite product.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: A favourite outranks a cheaper non-favourite candidate.

scoring.passCriteria: Basket line is the favourite Semi Skimmed, not the cheaper Whole Milk.
